summary: Strip 1 shows a cut at 7.43 with a small settle and no visible pop, and strip 2 shows no visible spike at 9.07. The face looks fairly static, with a faint head tilt and little expression change.

faults.what: Across 9.06-9.30 the face holds almost the same soft smile and direct stare with no blink or brow change. The head tilt is very slight, so 'he has us' reads weakly.
faults.fix: Add a blink and a small brow lift on the head tilt, and push the tilt a few degrees further.
